Request Franklin updates

Franklin Navigator will not add you to an email list just because you use the site, review a profile or use My Franklin. This request is separate and voluntary.

What you may receive

Useful local information, not a flood.

  • Useful local businesses and services
  • Franklin resources and community tools
  • Selected local events and opportunities

Your choices matter

Marketing updates will include an unsubscribe option. You can also email community@franklinnavigator.com and ask to stop marketing updates.

Franklin Navigator does not buy random resident email lists, scrape private addresses or create guessed email addresses.

Using a QR code?

Event booths, community partners, member locations and ambassadors can use this same page with a source code. The source tells Franklin Navigator how you found the site; it does not change your access or create a paid membership.

Recognized sources: website, event QR, member-display QR, ambassador and community partner.
